title: The sheaf of a graded module on Proj and the twisting sheaves O(d)
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}S_n$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. (1) For a graded $S$-module $M$, the sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules associated to $M$, written $\widetilde M$, is the sheaf $\mathcal F$ of [lem-weil-pbc-proj-graded-module-sheaf-exists] (b): $\Gamma(D_+(f),\widetilde M)=M_{(f)}$ as a module over $S_{(f)}=\Gamma(D_+(f),\mathcal O_X)$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero] for every homogeneous $f$ of positive degree, with the canonical restriction maps $M_{(f)}\to M_{(g)}$ for $D_+(g)\subseteq D_+(f)$. (2) For $d\in\mathbf Z$ the shifted graded module $M(d)$ has $M(d)_n=M_{d+n}$. The $d$-th twist of the structure sheaf is $\mathcal O_X(d)=\widetilde{S(d)}$; thus $\Gamma(D_+(f),\mathcal O_X(d))=S(d)_{(f)}=(S_f)_d$, the fractions $a/f^m$ with $a\in S_{m\deg f+d}$, an $S_{(f)}$-module by multiplication in $S_f$. (3) For $d\ge0$ and $s\in S_d$, the global section $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X(d))$ is the image of $s\in S(d)_0=S_d$ under the map of [lem-weil-pbc-proj-graded-module-sheaf-exists] (d): the unique global section whose restriction to every $D_+(f)$ is $s/1\in(S_f)_d$.
